title: 2024 AMC 10B Problem 9
statement: Real numbers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) have arithmetic mean \(0.\) The arithmetic mean of \(a^2,\) \(b^2,\) and \(c^2\) is \(10.\) What is the arithmetic mean of \(ab,\) \(ac,\) and \(bc?\)

solutions.text: The means tell us \(a + b + c = 0\) and \(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 30.\) Square the first: \((a+b+c)^2\) \(= a^2 + b^2 + c^2\) \(+ 2(ab + bc + ca),\) so \(0 = 30 + 2(ab + bc + ca)\) and \(ab + bc + ca = -15.\) Their mean is \(-\frac{15}{3} = -5.\) Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Mean \(0\) means \(a + b + c = 0;\) mean \(10\) means \(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 30\)
